meta.what: the three maps of wave W14, reduced from the grid

claims.A: the learned corrector is more accurate than the Boris scheme on the trajectory, at the same step
claims.B: the learned corrector is more accurate than vps4 at equal total flops
claims.C: the energy diagnostic does not show the trajectory error that has already accumulated

meta.primary_metric: root mean square of the position error in Larmor radii against the best reference of that configuration

P1.prediction: A holds only in the neighbourhood of the training step

P2.prediction: B holds nowhere on the grid

P3.prediction: C holds widely and is the real subject of the map

P4.prediction: negative control: if A holds widely or B holds anywhere, the predictions are wrong and that is the leading result
